problem_text:
A city planner needs to allocate the annual budget across 7 infrastructure projects to maximize total community benefit.  
The characteristics of each project are as follows:  
* Project P1: community benefit score 0.152, environmental impact score 0.016, allocation limits [0.044, 0.545]  
* Project P2: community benefit score 0.129, environmental impact score 0.232, allocation limits [0.028, 0.493]  
* Project P3: community benefit score 0.025, environmental impact score 0.248, allocation limits [0.100, 0.363]  
* Project P4: community benefit score 0.061, environmental impact score 0.177, allocation limits [0.044, 0.396]  
* Project P5: community benefit score 0.141, environmental impact score 0.231, allocation limits [0.081, 0.547]  
* Project P6: community benefit score 0.175, environmental impact score 0.061, allocation limits [0.097, 0.597]  
* Project P7: community benefit score 0.126, environmental impact score 0.160, allocation limits [0.047, 0.698]  

Each project must receive a budget share within its specified limits, and the total allocation across all projects must sum to one.  
To address urgent needs, the planner requires that the group of high-priority projects, represented by the set H = {P1, P2, P4, P5, P7}, collectively receive at least 0.244 of the total budget.  
At the same time, the overall environmental impact of the portfolio, measured by a composite index, must not exceed 0.214, and the total community benefit score must be no less than 0.096.  
Determine the optimal budget allocation that maximizes the total community benefit while satisfying all constraints.
